# Capture Index — NEMT Driver App

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-capture-index.ts. Do not hand-edit: run
     `bun run build:capture-index`, then `bun run verify:captures`. -->

Every production capture of the driver app held in this vault, deduplicated and indexed.

**Captures are ground truth; this repo's code is derived from them.** A section with no
capture is not one we have verified — it is one we have guessed at, and it carries a
`🕐 No capture` stamp in the Working Plan for exactly that reason.

## How this index works

⭐ **The index is the artifact; the image files stay where they are.** Each row carries the
capture's SHA-256 and its vault-relative path, so a capture is addressable without copying
~142.1 MB of binaries into a branch that every future prototype clones — and
without that cost growing with every shoot. Paths are relative to the vault root.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `CAP-###` | **stable id, owned by the bytes.** Assigned once from `cap-ids.json` and never reassigned, so a capture keeps its id through re-filing, renaming and later shoots. Ids are therefore NOT contiguous within a section. ⛔ Cite this, not a row number. |
| `Build` | **which shoot it came from** — the fidelity stamp. Never mix builds in one artifact |
| `SHA-256` | first 16 hex of the file's hash; the identity of the bytes |
| `Shows` | literal on-screen content, harvested from the Map Request View registry where one exists |
| `Dup` | byte-identical copies elsewhere in the vault |

## Builds

| Build | What it is | Look |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **MRV-B2** | 2026-09-24 · macOS simulator · 974×1614 | **Authoritative for layout and content.** Dark teal/navy map |
| MRV-B1 | 2026-09-05 · Android device · 1080×2460 | Light pale-green map |
| MRV-B3 | 2026-09-29 · real devices, Android 1080×2460 / iOS 942×2046 | Mostly device and store surfaces |
| BAL-B2 | Balance Dashboard, later batch (tagged `B2` in-file) | — |
| BAL-B1 | Balance Dashboard, earlier batch (untagged in-file) | ⚠️ No registry exists for this project, so the date is unrecorded |
| Apr-2026 | undated shoot; predates every MRV batch | The only real evidence for My Rides / Ride Details |
| Sep-2026 | prototype-repo canonical sets | Mixed provenance |
| unknown | untriaged inbox file; any date shown is read off the filename | — |

⚠️ **Build tags are namespaced by project.** Map Request View and the Balance Dashboard each
ran their own shoots and each label one of them `B2` in the filename, but they are different
batches on different dates. `MRV-B2` and `BAL-B2` are not the same shoot, and an artifact must
never mix shoots.

⛔ **The light-vs-dark map difference is PLATFORM, not product.** It tracks the capture
environment exactly — Android renders Google Maps, the macOS simulator renders Apple MapKit,
real devices render light again. Match the chrome; let the tiles be tiles.

⛔ The greyed-out Home control in every B2 capture is a simulator without location permission.

⛔ `Project - Map Request View/References/Request Map Demo 2.mov` **does not exist on disk**,
and predates the build in any case. It is not a source.
